title: Identification of Andrographolide as a novel FABP4 inhibitor for osteoarthritis treatment.
authors: Yang, Kuangyang; Xie, Qian; Liang, Jianhui; Shen, Yanni; Li, Ziqi; Zhao, Na; Wu, Yuanyan; Liu, Lichu; Zhang, Peng; Hu, Chun; Chen, Lei; Wang, Yan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯作为FABP4抑制剂治疗骨关节炎，涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Fatty acid binding protein 4 (FABP4) has been identified as a contributor to cartilage degradation in osteoarthritis (OA) patients, and inhibiting FABP4 using small molecules has emerged as a promising approach for developing OA drugs. Our previous research showed that Andrographis paniculata, a medicinal plant, strongly inhibits FABP4 activity. This led us to hypothesize that Andrographis paniculata ingredients might have protective effects on OA cartilage through FABP4 inhibition. METHODS: We analyzed scRNA-seq data from joint tissue of OA patients (GSE152805; GSE145286) using Scanpy 1.9.1 and Single Cell Portal. We conducted docking analysis of FABP4 inhibitors using Autodock Vina v.1.0.2. We evaluated the anti-FABP4 activity using a fluorescence displacement assay and measured the fatty acid oxidation (FAO) activity using the FAOBlue assay. We used H(2)DCF-DA to measure reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. We studied signaling pathways using bulk RNA sequencing and western blot analysis in human C28/I2 chondrocytes. We evaluated anti-OA activity in monosodium iodoacetate (MIA)-induced rats. RESULTS: We identified Andrographolide (AP) as a novel FABP4 inhibitor. Bulk RNA-sequencing analysis revealed that FABP4 upregulated FAO and ROS in chondrocytes, which was inhibited by AP. ROS generation activated the NF-kappaB pathway, leading to overexpression of a disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin motifs 4 (ADAMTS4), which is a responsible factor for cartilage degradation in OA patients. AP inhibited FABP4, thereby reducing the overexpression of ADAMTS4 by inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway. In MIA rats, AP treatment reduced the overexpression of ADAMTS4, repaired cartilage and subchondral bone, and promoted cartilage regeneration. CONCLUSION: Our results indicate that the inhibition of FABP4 activity by AP explains the anti-OA properties of Andrographis paniculata by protecting against cartilage degradation in OA patients. Additionally, our findings suggest that AP may be a promising therapeutic agent for OA treatment due to its ability to alleviate cartilage damage and bone erosion.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：脂肪酸结合蛋白4（FABP4）已被确定为骨关节炎（OA）患者软骨降解的一个促成因素，而使用小分子抑制FABP4已成为开发OA药物的一种有前景的方法。我们先前的研究表明，药用植物穿心莲（Andrographis paniculata）能强烈抑制FABP4活性。这使我们假设穿心莲成分可能通过抑制FABP4对OA软骨具有保护作用。方法：我们使用Scanpy 1.9.1和Single Cell Portal分析了OA患者关节组织的scRNA-seq数据（GSE152805；GSE145286）。我们使用Autodock Vina v.1.0.2对FABP4抑制剂进行了对接分析。我们使用荧光置换实验评估了抗FABP4活性，并使用FAOBlue实验测量了脂肪酸氧化（FAO）活性。我们使用H(2)DCF-DA测量了活性氧（ROS）水平。我们在人C28/I2软骨细胞中通过批量RNA测序和western blot分析研究了信号通路。我们在单碘乙酸（MIA）诱导的大鼠中评估了抗OA活性。结果：我们鉴定出穿心莲内酯（AP）为一种新型FABP4抑制剂。批量RNA测序分析显示，FABP4上调了软骨细胞中的FAO和ROS，而AP抑制了这种上调。ROS生成激活了NF-kappaB通路，导致含血小板反应蛋白基序的解整合素和金属蛋白酶4（ADAMTS4）过表达，这是OA患者软骨降解的一个关键因素。AP抑制了FABP4，从而通过抑制NF-kappaB通路减少了ADAMTS4的过表达。在MIA大鼠中，AP治疗减少了ADAMTS4的过表达，修复了软骨和软骨下骨，并促进了软骨再生。结论：我们的结果表明，AP对FABP4活性的抑制解释了穿心莲通过保护OA患者免受软骨降解而具有的抗OA特性。此外，我们的发现提示，AP可能因其缓解软骨损伤和骨侵蚀的能力而成为OA治疗的一种有前景的治疗剂。
